name: SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES_INT
description: This table is used to store the resources who are members of a queue.

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: One of the columns that makes up the data to be copied for this table. Also this is column sames as base table .

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: One of the columns that makes up the composite primary key for this table. Also a foreign key that references either HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID) for the resource ID or JTF_RS_TEAMS (TEAM_ID) for the resource team ID.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on ourcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record begin updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Indicates type of resource - RESOURCE or TEAM

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the resource is enabled (Y or N) for the queue

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this queue resource record is logically deleted (Y or N)

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to the table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required to track multi csv import of service request objects

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: QUEUE_RES_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Additional column to resolve POSTED_BY_PARTY_ID using alternate key QUEUE_RESOURCES_PARTY_NUMBER

columns.name: QUEUE_RES_PARTY_ORIG_SYS
columns.description: Additional column to resolve POSTED_BY_PARTY_ID using origninal system key

columns.name: QUEUE_RES_PARTY_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Additional column to resolve POSTED_BY_PARTY_ID using origninal system reference key

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if reco rd was imported.

columns.name: TEAM_NUMBER
columns.description: Specifies the team number of JTF_RS_TEAMS_B, if record was imported.

columns.name: QUEUE_OSR
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference of Queue, if record was imported.

columns.name: QUEUE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Specifies the resource id of the queue resource.
